title: Backup & restore
warning: Backups are unencrypted and contain all data including password hashes. A backup on the same drive does not protect against a disk failure: download the files or copy the backup directory externally.

blocked.notAllowed: Restore is not enabled in this environment.

restored.title: Restore successful. Restart required.
restored.safety: The state before the restore is in the list as the safety copy {{name}}. Restart the server (Docker: docker compose restart, otherwise restart the service or process) and then sign in again.

empty: No backups yet. “Create backup now” creates the first one.
caption: Backups

delete.title: Delete backup?
delete.body: {{name}} will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
delete.beforeRestore: This is the safety copy from an earlier restore: the state at that time can no longer be restored afterwards.

settings.title: Settings
settings.scheduleTip: Backup:Schedule — daily start time as HH:mm in UTC
settings.retentionTip: Backup:RetentionCount — older backups are deleted after each new one
settings.invalidSchedule: The schedule “{{schedule}}” is invalid (expected: HH:mm in UTC, e.g. 02:00). No scheduled backups are running.
settings.noSchedule: No schedule set: backups are only created manually. For daily backups set Backup__Schedule (e.g. 02:00, UTC).
settings.restoreBlockedNote: Restore is blocked here. To restore, set Backup__AllowRestore=true and restart the server (only for the duration of the restore).
settings.dirCustom: The backups are in the configured backup directory (Backup__Directory).
settings.dirDefault: The backups are next to the database; with Backup__Directory another directory (e.g. a dedicated volume) can be set.
settings.readOnly: The settings are read-only here; they come from the server configuration.

mysql.title: MySQL: backup with mysqldump
mysql.intro: Backup and restore through the application only exist for SQLite. The MySQL database is backed up with mysqldump (regularly, e.g. via cron) and restored with the mysql client:
mysql.note: Replace placeholders in angle brackets. Dumps contain all data including password hashes: store them protected.

memory: The database is not stored in a file (in-memory): backup and restore are not possible.

restore.title: Restore the database?
restore.label: Restore now
restore.warnTitle: Warning: the running database will be replaced.
restore.warn1: All changes since the state of the chosen backup are lost (stock, orders, users, passwords).
restore.warn2: Beforehand, the current state is stored as the safety copy “before-restore”; it is kept.
restore.warn3: Afterwards the server must be restarted; until then the application still works with the old connection.
restore.tooBig: The file is {{size}}, larger than allowed ({{max}}).
